verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo the same way, zooming in on the figs and losing the cake/tart, which weakens fidelity, and both float the wreath title in the dark upper-middle with lots of empty dark space on the left. A's wreath and title are a bit larger, so the headline is a stronger focal point, although its lower-right leaves brush the fig (the original also does this); B's lockup is smaller and clear of the fruit but undersized for a 768-wide banner, so the message reads weaker.
